verdicts.reason: A re-wraps the headline into four large, centred lines that fill the portrait canvas, with the dark CTA clearly below it, so the hierarchy and brand feel survive. Its flaw is vertical imbalance: about 170px of space above the headline but only about 50px below the CTA, so the group sits low and the button is crowded toward the bottom edge. B leaves the whole bottom ~45% of the canvas as dead orange because the block sits above centre. Its two-line headline runs almost to the side edges with thin margins, and the CTA is jammed close under the headline, so it reads like the landscape layout pasted in rather than rearranged for the new shape.
